expectations.text: Audience characterized at a useful specificity — narrow enough that some direction shapes are clearly right and some clearly wrong
expectations.evidence: Para 1 narrows from 'small-business owner' to 'sole proprietor or single-member LLC filing a Schedule C, not a payroll-having S-corp' with explicit market segmentation; specific enough to filter directions.

expectations.text: Current state of the landscape named — what tools or services the audience uses today, and the named ways those tools fail
expectations.evidence: Para 2 names four landscape categories (TurboTax/H&R Block consumer software, paid preparers, IRS Free File/Direct File, bookkeeping-first tools like QuickBooks/Bench) each with documented failure modes.

expectations.text: Real research signals only — aggregate signals, sourced findings, paraphrased user behavior; no fabricated quotes; no composite case studies with first-name attribution
expectations.evidence: All aggregate signals; cites named bodies and authors (ProPublica's Elliott and Kiel; Slemrod). No invented personas or first-name composites.

expectations.text: Citations or (Inferred) markers on empirical claims — sources cited where claims are empirical; (Inferred) marks extensions
expectations.evidence: IRS SOI, NTA Annual Reports, GAO, NACAA, FTC 2024 order, Pew, JPMC Institute, NFIB, Federal Reserve, Slemrod all cited; four (Inferred) markers explicitly flag extensions.

expectations.text: Source-quality hierarchy respected AND the highest-tier source available was reached for — primary government, peer-reviewed, or established non-profit sources used where they exist for this domain
expectations.evidence: Primary government (IRS, GAO, NTA, FTC, Federal Reserve), peer-reviewed (Slemrod), established research orgs (Pew, JPMC Institute, NFIB); ProPublica only used for landscape-failure claims not covered by gov sources.

expectations.text: Strategic, not execution — every claim passes the operational test; no rendering-layer guidance appears
expectations.evidence: All claims affect which directions are worth pursuing; no rendering, component, or visual-design content.

expectations.text: No success criteria smuggled in — quantified targets and KPIs are absent
expectations.evidence: No quantified targets for the design. Magnitudes used qualitatively or tied to sourced regulatory measures, not the design's success bar.

expectations.text: No direction candidates smuggled in for the design — solution-shape proposals for the design are absent; landscape players (what the audience confronts today) is fine
expectations.evidence: Final paragraph names the strategic gap without proposing solution shapes; landscape items are existing players the audience confronts, not design proposals.

expectations.text: No execution-layer guidance — no typography, contrast, sizing, motion, ARIA, copy-pattern specifics
expectations.evidence: No execution-layer rendering content anywhere in the doc.
Five short paragraphs (audience; landscape; behavioral context; audience variance; strategic positioning); within range.
